build_data_processor_pipeline: build a DataProcessor pipeline with processor configs to preprocess 3D point cloud data for training
create_mask_points_outside_range: create a function to mask points and ground truth boxes outside the point cloud range
shuffle_point_cloud_data: shuffle the points in a data dictionary for training augmentation using random permutation
transform_points_to_voxels: transform raw point cloud points into voxel grid format using spconv VoxelGenerator
sample_points_from_cloud: sample a fixed number of points from a point cloud preserving far points and filling with near points
